body:
## Review — LIN-4393

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2377 at head `0e81c6c2c8d9535eee124d3d60bd5c107aba75ce` (base `3272fe4a6`). It is open and mergeable. Since then `main` has moved to `3bfa70b29`, which touches only `docs/reviews/**` and `docs/areas/front-end-pages.md`, so nothing overlaps this change.

CI: green on `0e81c6c2c`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success all passed.

### Against what was asked
- **"Settings no longer offers the setting."** Met. The Running row, the "Size policy set" row, the Undo row, `POST /settings/running/size-policy`, its undo sink, `loadSizePolicy`/`setSizePolicy`, the `settings-areas` feature and route entries, and the "Ready · larger/ask" state are all removed. Running reads `Runner ready` / `No runner`. A test confirms the testids are gone and the old route returns 404 with the stored preference left unchanged.
- **"Harbour keeps running hands-off … behaving as it does now with … 'err larger'."** Met. `STANDING_POLICY_LINE` (`lib/size-of-move.js`) is a constant, and scoping renders it on every path. The old no-policy `DECISION:` clause is gone. `size-policy-render.test.js` drives every scoping entrance (the dispatch-entrance override arm, proxy `/prompt`, proxy `/recommend?kind=scoping`, in-app prompt, routed input), each with no stored value and with a stored `ask`.
- **"Tidying that falls out of the removal is fine. Anything else goes to the area notes."** Met. The completion-signal wording, `survey.md` §How the choice is made, `source-map.md` and `ui-pieces.md` are updated. John's "per task breakdown" remark and the five hand-built prompt contexts are Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`. No new tickets.
- **Not this ticket ("settings … for discussion").** Nothing was touched there.
- **"Done when … nothing that existed only for the setting remains."** Met. `git grep` on the PR head for `sizePolicy|loadSizePolicy|setSizePolicy|formatSizePolicyLine|SIZE_POLICIES|DEFAULT_SIZE_POLICY|size-policy|POLICY_MEANING|Ask each time` finds only:
  - the change-log retirement note and `SIZE_POLICY_WORDS`, kept on purpose so old rows still read;
  - the `workspace-preferences.js` "retired" note;
  - prompt change-log history and tests;
  - `docs/reviews/**` evidence, which is history and correctly untouched.
  `llms.txt` and `proxy-instructions.js` never named the setting.
- **Scope comment's extra condition (John's old row still reads and offers nothing broken).** Met. `SETTINGS` drops `sizePolicy`, `mergeChangeLog` marks retired rows not undoable, and `WorkspaceChangeLogStore.undo` refuses them `NOT_UNDOABLE` before `readCurrent`/`apply`. That closes the feature-flag fallthrough Survey open-0 #3 found. `preferences.sizePolicy` is left stored and unread, with no migration, as the PR states.
- **Kept, as required.** `DECIDED_BY` (all three values), every `SIZE_RECORD_*` guard including `SIZE_RECORD_POLICY_CUT`, the cut sentence ("the standing policy never decides one"), the size record, look-first and the selector fact. "The standing policy" wording is unchanged.

No narrowing. The implementation comment records no cuts, and I found none.

### Regression check
`git log` on the touched files shows only LIN-4368 (which added the setting), LIN-4369 replay arms and LIN-4370 look-first, plus older Settings work. LIN-4369 arm 4 wording ("scoping posts no comment", the record-shape lines) and LIN-4370's look-first sentence are intact in the scoping template. Nothing reverted is re-applied. Nothing in the ticket's paths changed after the ticket was created except through this PR.

### Mutation checks (LIN-2274), all reverted
- Deleted the store guard `if (!SETTINGS.includes(entry.setting)) throw … NOT_UNDOABLE` (`lib/workspace-change-log.js`). Red: "refuses NOT_UNDOABLE for a retired setting, before readCurrent or apply runs" and the route test "a forged Undo of the old row is refused not_undoable…".
- Dropped `SETTINGS.includes(r.setting)` from `mergeChangeLog`'s `undoable`. Red: "a change to a retired setting reads, and is not undoable" and "John's old change row still reads, with no Undo on the Change log or on Running".
- Put the old "no standing policy" line back in place of `STANDING_POLICY_LINE` in the scoping template. Red: all three proxy entrances, the override arm, the no-store render, and both `lin-4369-scoping-size-record` built-in-policy tests.

Local run of the 8 touched test files on the PR head: 150/150 pass.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is a retired setting that still has logged history. `sizePolicy` is the only setting ever removed from `SETTINGS`, and the builder's new lesson in `docs/areas/auth-accounts-and-workspaces.md` records the pattern for next time. The other class is a context field threaded through the scoping renders by hand. That is the five hand-built contexts, already a Waiting entry in `llm-and-prompts.md`, and it is outside this ticket because John bounded it to the area notes. Otherwise the change is isolated.

### Leftovers
I agree with the builder's `### Leftovers`. The context-builder duplication is a Waiting note, the stale scoping-pointer note is tidied, and close-out has nothing to tidy. I found no other loose ends. `workspacePreferencesStore` is still used for other reads in every file that keeps it, and the only thing removed from `createPromptsRoutes` is the dependency it no longer reads.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the setting's removal, the As-asked "Settings no longer offers the setting" plus the scope comment's old-row condition). **After the deploy:** open Settings › Running on the JKershaw workspace. There should be no "Size of the move" row and the sidebar should read `Runner ready`/`No runner`. On the Change log, John's 7 Nov row should read "Size of the move: err larger" with **no Undo button**. CI seeds this row's shape; only the live page shows the real stored row (`setting: 'sizePolicy', from: 'ask', to: 'err-larger'`).
- **Inside** (hands-off err-larger, the As-asked "a task runs hands-off without asking about size"). **After the deploy:** the next live scoping run on a fresh ticket should write a `## Size of the move` record with `Decided by: the standing policy` and raise no size `DECISION:` for a non-cut size. CI proves the prompt; only a live run shows the model follows it now that no workspace has a stored value to lean on.
- **Rollback:** revert the squash commit of #2377. That is safe because no data was migrated: `preferences.sizePolicy` is still stored, so the reverted code would read John's `err-larger` again.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger
